source:
"Curiosity killed a lot. Should you look for an elisive border of reality, lurk inside occult chats, and investigate the urban legends of a small Russian town G. Try to pull grains of truth from all the rumors and strange incidents. If you look into the unknown, someone will notice your interest. Forbidden knowledge is always luring you into madness. Are you sure you want to check them?"
